items.title: Return completed damage questionnaire and Wildschadenbescheinigung
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: The letter itself fixes the start of the period as its own date (21.11.2026, a Saturday), not the delivery date, and defines 'Werktage' as Monday to Saturday excluding statutory public holidays. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (21.11.2026) is not counted, so counting of Werktage begins 22.11.2026 (a Sunday, not a Werktag). Counting only Mon-Sat: Werktag 1 = Mon 23.11, 2 = Tue 24.11, 3 = Wed 25.11, 4 = Thu 26.11, 5 = Fri 27.11, 6 = Sat 28.11, (Sun 29.11 skipped), 7 = Mon 30.11, 8 = Tue 01.12, 9 = Wed 02.12, 10 = Thu 03.12, 11 = Fri 04.12, 12 = Sat 05.12, (Sun 06.12 skipped), 13 = Mon 07.12.2026. No public holidays fall in this window in NRW. The 13th Werktag (07.12.2026) is itself a working Monday, so no further weekend/holiday shift is needed.
